title: feat(rest,console): a record open is one request; the page payload carries the record's streams and the related rows' names
body:
domain:ui#4 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jR7ZFkpqmm4U8S1f9y

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBLJwakjtd38ozmWiE7HN9i)_

Fixes #28470

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：打开一条记录时，评论、动态、附件和关联行里引用记录的名称，都跟着 `POST /data/:object/:id/page` 一起返回；@ 提及候选人（`sys_user?top=50`）改为评论框第一次获得焦点时才读。打开记录不再单独发这些请求，也没有回退读取。
- **为什么改**：在 app-crm 的生产构建上实测，打开一个联系人除了 `/page` 之外还会发 `sys_comment`、`sys_activity`、`sys_user?top=50`，以及每个被引用对象一次 `?top=1` 名称查询，共 8 个多余请求。
- **风险与回滚**：协议只增不减（Clause-② 加宽，Metadata-protocol: added，`@objectstack/spec` minor），新字段全部可选，旧客户端不受影响；每个新部件单独拒绝，不会连累整页。回滚就是还原本 PR。动态部件一次取 200 条，这是已命名的偏差，见下文。
- **先看**：`packages/spec/src/api/record-page.zod.ts`（新成员和流表说明）、`packages/rest/src/record-page-routes.ts`（每个部件就是它替代的那次读）、`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`（何时请求各部件）；文档 `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx` 的 Console Integration 一节改为讲记录页请求。
- **两分钟验证**：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.recordOpenOneRequest-28470.test.tsx`，五条通过：一次 `/page`，零次评论、动态、附件、提及候选和 `?top=1` 读取，含两条消融。
- **需要你做的**：总监做合约审查（CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER）。声明行已按席位修订的认领改为 `Metadata-protocol: added`，`@objectstack/spec` 定为 minor。PR 保持草稿。

## What changes

One record open is one request. The parts a record page still read on its own after the page payload answered now ride in `POST /api/v1/data/{object}/{id}/page`, and the console takes them from there with no fallback read.

### Contract members added (one complete list for the contract review)

`@objectstack/spec` (`packages/spec/src/api/record-page.zod.ts`, exported from `@objectstack/spec/api`):

Request (`RecordPageRequestSchema`, still `.strict()`):
- `related[].expand?: string[]`: the lookups of a related list's rows to resolve, as that list read's own `$expand`.
- `discussion?: boolean`: ask for the record's comment thread and its reactions.
- `activity?: { top: int 1..200 }` (`RecordPageActivityRequestSchema`, strict): ask for the newest activity rows and their count.
- `attachments?: { top: int 0..100 }` (`RecordPageAttachmentsRequestSchema`, strict): ask for the newest attachments and their count.

Response (`RecordPageResponseSchema`):
- `discussion?: { comments, reactions } | { error }` (`RecordPageDiscussionSchema` | `RecordPageStreamRefusalSchema`). `reactions` is `{ records } | { error }` (`RecordPageDiscussionReactionsSchema`), so a refused reaction read leaves the comments answered.
- `activity?: { total, records } | { error }` (`RecordPageStreamRowsSchema` | `RecordPageStreamRefusalSchema`).
- `attachments?: { total, records } | { error }` (same pair).

New exports: `RecordPageActivityRequestSchema`, `RecordPageAttachmentsRequestSchema`, `RecordPageStreamRefusalSchema`, `RecordPageStreamRowsSchema`, `RecordPageDiscussionReactionsSchema`, `RecordPageDiscussionSchema`, `RECORD_PAGE_MAX_ACTIVITY_ROWS` (200), `RECORD_PAGE_MAX_ATTACHMENT_ROWS` (100), and for each schema its `X` (input) and `XParsed` (output) type.

`@object-ui/types` (`ui/packages/types/src/data.ts`, published):
- `RecordPagePayload.discussion?: { comments: Record<string, any>[]; reactions: { records: Record<string, any>[] } | { error: RecordPagePartRefusal } } | { error: RecordPagePartRefusal }`
- `RecordPagePayload.activity?: { total: number; records: Record<string, any>[] } | { error: RecordPagePartRefusal }`
- `RecordPagePayload.attachments?: { total: number; records: Record<string, any>[] } | { error: RecordPagePartRefusal }`
- The request type is the spec's `RecordPageRequest`, re-exported, so it gains the request members above with no separate declaration.

`@object-ui/react`: `DiscussionContextValue.onMentionSuggestionsWanted?: () => void`.

`@object-ui/plugin-detail`: `RichTextCommentInput`, `RecordActivityTimeline` and `RecordChatterPanel` take `onMentionSuggestionsWanted?: () => void`, called on the editor's focus. `record:activity` and `record:chatter` pass the context's hook.

### What each new part answers

Each part is the read it replaces, asked as the same caller, behind the stream object's own API exposure gate, and refused on its own:

| Part | The read it replaces |
| --- | --- |
| `related[].expand` | the related list read's own `$expand` (`GET /data/{child}?$expand=…`), spelled as the QueryAST relation map that read's normalizer lowers it to |
| `discussion.comments` | `GET /data/sys_comment` where `thread_id` = `{object}:{id}`, oldest first, no page size |
| `discussion.reactions` | `GET /data/sys_comment_reaction` where `comment_id` in those comments, oldest first; not asked when the thread is empty |
| `activity` | `GET /data/sys_activity` for the record, newest first, `$top`, `$count`, `$expand=actor_id` |
| `attachments` | `GET /data/sys_attachment` for the record, newest first, `$top`, `$count` |

A record the caller cannot read still refuses the whole request, its thread with it. The body stays strict and the query-parameter set stays empty.

### Console

- The page asks `discussion` and `activity` when a block that draws the feed is on screen at open (the 动态 panel of a laid-out page, or a feed block on the tab the page opens on), and `attachments` when the page draws them. The feed, the Attachments panel and the Attachments tab badge draw those parts. A refused part draws the refusal the panel draws today.
- The stream asks ride whichever payload the plan asks and never key it, so an assigned page landing after a synthesized one asks nothing again (objectui#11699 stays green).
- Each related list asks the lookups of its rows to resolve (every declared reference of the child but the parent's, gated by field-level security), so the rows carry their names.
- `RelatedList`'s name fallback no longer resolves the parent record's own id, which no column draws.
- The mention roster (`sys_user`, 50 rows) is read on the composer's first focus. A reply or an edit whose text holds an `@` before then reads it when written, so its mentions still resolve.

### Docs

- `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx`, the "Console Integration" section only (added to the file surface by claim amendment). It showed the console reading a record's comments with `dataSource.find('sys_comment', …)`, with field names already stale on `main`. It now says a record open takes the discussion and the activity from the `/page` payload, and names when the console still reads `sys_comment` itself (a feed the open did not ask for, or a data source without `getRecordPage`) and when it reads the mention list. Its snippet calls `getRecordPage` with the real types. The rest of the page is unchanged.

### The `?top=1` probe caller

`RelatedList`'s reference-name fallback (`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`) resolving the payload's bare ids in related rows, one `GET /data/{object}?top=1&filter=["id","in",[…]]` per referenced object, the parent FK itself among them. The rows now arrive expanded, and the parent FK is skipped.

### Named deviation: the activity part asks 200 rows

The 动态 panel shows 3 or 5 rows, but its count chip and the 动态 tab count the whole merged stream (comments + activity + field changes, minus dropped types). A 5-row window would make that count wrong, so the part asks the same 200-row window the console's own read asked before. Shrinking it needs a server-side count of the merged stream: see `out_of_scope_findings`.

Follow-up: #28737 serves the merged 动态 count with the page payload, so the activity part can ask the panel's few rows. It owns `RECORD_PAGE_MAX_ACTIVITY_ROWS`.

### `/page` once per open (card item 4)

Measured on a production build before this change: `/page` goes out once per record. The two other `/page` posts in a drawer open are the previous/next prefetch (#27056, #27545), different ids, by design. So item 4 changes nothing, and the seat recorded it out of scope.

### App-level reads a record open causes (out of scope, left to #28085 / #27626)

- In a drawer open: `GET /api/v1/meta/object` (the object list read again on open) and `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_user_preference/{id}` (the recent-items write). Neither is the record's, and neither is changed here.
- On the record route, the other 26 requests are the shell's own boot (runtime config, session, discovery, translations, organizations, auth config, the preference read, `meta/app`, `meta/view`, `meta/page`, `meta/object`, `meta/dashboard`, the app bundle, packages, permissions, localization, settings, AI agents, the approvals inbox, `sys_inbox_message`, `sys_user/{me}` and `meta/object/sys_user`) plus the same preference write. A record open does not cause them.

## Before / after

Measured on `examples/app-crm`, production-built Console (`pnpm build && pnpm console:build`, `pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh --ui --no-watch`), Playwright, signed in as admin, every `/api/` request from the click (drawer) or navigation (record route) until network idle plus 3 s. HotCRM was not available, so app-crm stands in.

**Contact drawer** (open "Ada Lovelace" from the Contacts list): 13 requests before, 4 after.

```
before                                                                      after
 1. GET   /meta/object                                                       1. GET   /meta/object
 2. POST  /data/crm_contact/{ada}/page                                       2. POST  /data/crm_contact/{ada}/page
 3. GET   /data/sys_user?top=50&select=id,name,email,image                      (read on the composer's first focus)
 4. GET   /data/sys_comment?sort=created_at&filter=thread_id = crm_contact:{ada}  (in /page: discussion)
 5. GET   /data/sys_activity?populate=actor_id&top=200&sort=timestamp&…         (in /page: activity)
 6. POST  /data/crm_contact/{prev}/page     neighbour prefetch               3. POST  /data/crm_contact/{other}/page   neighbour prefetch
 7. POST  /data/crm_contact/{next}/page     neighbour prefetch
 8. GET   /data/sys_organization?top=1&filter=id in [...]                       (related rows arrive expanded)
 9. GET   /data/sys_user?top=1&filter=id in [...]                               (related rows arrive expanded)
10. GET   /data/crm_contact?top=1&filter=id in [{ada}]                          (the parent FK: no longer resolved)
11. GET   /data/crm_account?top=1&filter=id in [...]                            (related rows arrive expanded)
12. GET   /data/crm_opportunity?top=1&filter=id in [...]                        (related rows arrive expanded)
13. PATCH /data/sys_user_preference/{id}                                     4. PATCH /data/sys_user_preference/{id}
```

The after run has one neighbour prefetch instead of two only because the fresh seed listed Ada third of three (no next row); the prefetch is unchanged.

**Account drawer** (open "Acme Corp"): 13 requests before, 5 after: `GET /meta/object`, `POST /data/crm_account/{acme}/page`, the two neighbour prefetches, `PATCH /data/sys_user_preference/{id}`. Gone: `sys_user?top=50`, `sys_comment`, `sys_activity`, and the five `?top=1` probes (`sys_organization`, `sys_user`, `crm_contact`, `crm_account`, `crm_opportunity`). The page request body:

```json
{"expand":["organization_id","created_by","updated_by","owner_id","owning_business_unit_id"],"related":[{"object":"crm_activity","field":"account","top":3,"expand":["organization_id","created_by","updated_by","owner_id","owning_business_unit_id","contact","opportunity"]},{"object":"crm_contact","field":"account","top":3,"expand":["organization_id","created_by","updated_by","owner_id","owning_business_unit_id"]},{"object":"crm_lead","field":"account","top":3,"expand":["organization_id","created_by","updated_by","owner_id","owning_business_unit_id","converted_opportunity"]},{"object":"crm_opportunity","field":"account","top":3,"expand":["organization_id","created_by","updated_by","owner_id","owning_business_unit_id","renewal_of"]}],"explain":["update","delete","transfer"],"fieldAccess":true,"approvals":true,"discussion":true,"activity":{"top":200}}
```

**Contact record route** (navigate to `/apps/crm_app/crm_contact/record/{ada}`, shell boot included): 37 requests before, 28 after. The nine gone: `sys_user?top=50`, `sys_comment`, `sys_activity`, the five `?top=1` probes, and `GET /meta/object/sys_organization` (the schema read the name fallback made for the `sys_organization` probe). Nothing was added.

**Composer focus** (account drawer, then a click into "Write a note… @ to mention"): one `GET /data/sys_user?top=50&select=id,name,email,image`, at the focus, and none before it.

App-crm does not enable files on these objects, so `attachments` is not asked here; the console test and the dogfood suite cover that part.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/api/record-page.test.ts`: request strictness for the new members (unknown key in `activity` / `attachments` refused, bounds), and each stream part is its rows or its refusal, never both and never neither.
- `packages/rest/src/record-page-routes.test.ts` (7 new, 20 total): each part's read as replaced, for the same caller; an empty thread asks no reaction read; per-part refusal (a refused activity read leaves the others answered); a refused comment read; a refused reaction read keeps the comments; the stream object's exposure gate; strict body.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/record-page-streams.dogfood.test.ts` (new, real HTTP + security stack, non-admin member): discussion, reactions and activity equal the member's own `GET` reads byte for byte, including a `top: 1` window with the whole count; a private record refuses the whole request as `GET` does; attachments count and list only the record's own (3), never another record's (2 secret).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/record-page.dogfood.test.ts`: a related list's `expand` is its read's own `$expand`.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.recordOpenOneRequest-28470.test.tsx` (new, real `ObjectStackAdapter`, StrictMode): one `/page`; zero `sys_comment`, `sys_comment_reaction`, `sys_activity`, `sys_attachment`, `sys_user?top=50` and `?top=1` reads; the body asks `discussion`, `activity` 200, `attachments` 100 and the related `expand`; the feed, the attachment and the badge draw the payload; the mention read goes out once, on the composer's focus; a refused activity draws `data-denied-source="activity"` and is not read again. Ablations: with no `getRecordPage` the detectors see the `sys_activity`, `sys_attachment` and `sys_comment` reads; with the related `expand` ignored they see the `?top=1` name probe. Removing the parent-FK skip was checked to go red, then restored.
- Updated to the payload behavior: `RecordDetailView.recordPagePayload-27627`, `RecordDetailView.recordOpenWaves-13010`, `RecordDetailView.withheldMentions-28218` (the composer reads the roster on focus; a reply reads it at the write).
- `ui/apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.servedPage.test.tsx`: it pinned the related timeline's label read of its parent `request_id`, which the related `expand` retires. It now asserts no read of the parent request by id, and still that no read the page makes is refused.

## Acceptance notes

- Contract tests: each new part answers the read it replaces for the same caller (route unit tests + dogfood as a member); a refused part is refused on its own; the body is strict.
- Console test: one `/page`, zero `sys_comment`, `sys_activity`, `sys_attachment`, `sys_user?top=50` and `?top=1` reads, with ablations.
- Before/after request lists: above.
- Preview check is the epic seat's.

## Deviations

- **The activity part asks 200 rows**, as named above.
- **The discussion part is the whole thread, with no page size.** The card asked for the discussion's first page. The part answers the read it replaces: on `main` the console read the whole thread (`sys_comment` where `thread_id` is `{object}:{id}`, oldest first, no `$top`) and held all of it, and the comment thread has no paging door today. A page size needs that door first, which is outside this card.

## out_of_scope_findings

- **class b, reach: every record page with a 动态 panel or tab** — a server-side count of the merged 动态 stream (comments + activity + field changes, minus the types the panel drops), so the activity part can ask the panel's 3 or 5 rows instead of 200 and the count chip still holds. Today the count is the client's, over the rows it holds, which is why the part asks 200.
